subject: maths
question: A shopkeeper buys a table fan marked at ₹2,600 on 18% discount. He marked it for ₹2,800 and allows a 15% discount. How much does he earn?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Cost Price (CP) for the shopkeeper = 82% of ₹2600 = ₹2132

Selling Price (SP) of the shopkeeper = 85% of ₹2800 = ₹2380

Earnings (Profit) = SP − CP = 2380 − 2132 = ₹248

**∴ The correct answer is ₹248.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial Marked Price (MP₁) = ₹2600

Discount allowed to shopkeeper = 18%

New Marked Price set by shopkeeper (MP₂) = ₹2800

Discount allowed to customer = 15%

**Formula Used:**

Selling Price (SP) = MP × (100 − D%) ÷ 100

Profit = SP − CP

**Calculations:**

⇒ Cost Price for shopkeeper (CP) = 2600 × (100 − 18) ÷ 100

⇒ CP = 2600 × 82 ÷ 100 = ₹2132

⇒ Selling Price of shopkeeper (SP) = 2800 × (100 − 15) ÷ 100

⇒ SP = 2800 × 85 ÷ 100 = ₹2380

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/27cd4fd1a5ecd25f1f425a05a8395ee0ca936355c86b597b6838d1328eaee6c6.png] 

⇒ Earnings = SP − CP

⇒ Earnings = 2380 − 2132 = ₹248

**∴ The correct answer is ₹248.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Marked Price and Discount

Discount is always calculated on the Marked Price (MP) unless specified otherwise. SP = MP − Discount.

Profit and Loss

Profit is earned when Selling Price (SP) is greater than Cost Price (CP). Profit = SP − CP, and Profit % = (Profit ÷ CP) × 100.

Successive Discount

When two consecutive discounts x% and y% are given, the equivalent single discount is (x + y − xy ÷ 100)%.
